title.zh: Bene SelfSpell · 自身技能提醒

summary.zh: 为自身增益、技能、饰品与药水设置计时和组合条件，并通过文字、语音或音效提醒。
summary.en: Configure timers and combined conditions for personal buffs, abilities, trinkets, and potions, with text, voice, and sound reminders.

zh: 技能、饰品、物品和被动触发监控
组合条件与多种提醒时机
计时条、图标和文字语音展示
en: Ability, trinket, item, and proc monitors
Timer bars, icons, text, and voice display
